about: 20 help-desk questions with the route a person chose for each. Written for Episode 12 by Ravi Shanker Singh. None of them is an example in embed_router.py. 'tricky' marks questions that look like another route.

questions.question: Can I get my money back if my lunch never arrived?
Do you deliver to Hinjewadi Phase 3?
What does the Protein Plus monthly plan cost?
questions.tricky: asks for a number, but it is a price list rule

questions.question: How many days a month can I pause my plan?
questions.tricky: starts with 'how many', but it is a rule

questions.question: Is the kitchen completely nut-free?

How many Jain thalis were sold last week?
Which thali was ordered most in September?
What was our add-on revenue in October?
How many dinners did we deliver on 16 October?

Good morning! How is your day going?
Thanks, that was really helpful.

questions.tricky: mentions Pune, but it is not about Dabbaloop

questions.tricky: mentions yesterday, like an orders question
